purpose: Prospective test of the farm-level protocol on a farm collected after submission (Seremban, 2026-10-11).

test_set.preprocessing: Roboflow export, auto-orient, resize 640x640 (Stretch), as in the submitted paper

metric: mAP50 over the classes present on the farm (Ultralytics val, imgsz 640, default conf/iou), averaged over seeds then folds (each fold = one LOFO model set that never saw the farm)

predictions.P1_primary: yolo11n mean mAP50 on Seremban < 0.3255 (midpoint of LOFO 0.223 and random-split 0.428), i.e. closer to the LOFO estimate than to the random-split estimate
predictions.P2: yolo11n mean mAP50 on Seremban lies within the per-farm range [0.094, 0.356]
predictions.P3: the five detector families' Seremban means differ by at most 0.05 mAP50 (the farm, not the detector, sets the score)
predictions.P4: if both psyllid classes are present, at least one of them is among the two lowest-AP classes for yolo11n

notes: Before annotation, images whose disease symptoms were too ambiguous to label confidently were removed by the annotator (visual judgement only; no model predictions were viewed). Retained: 82 distinct photos. This removal favours higher mAP50, i.e. it works against prediction P1.
